Functional: Restore work in Codex-only installations

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - a repo uses `tools = "codex"` on a machine with Codex but no Claude or Codex SDK, then upgrades with `codex_fast` absent. The new routing sends every build and repair through the SDK, and `worker.py:456-459` refuses to start without it. These installations previously ran workers natively. The suggested `forge doctor --fix` cannot repair them: `doctor.py:352-355,364` checks and installs the Codex SDK for a Codex-only repo only when Claude is also on PATH. Consequently, the repo cannot run its main work flow.
findings.title: Functional: Restore work in Codex-only installations

stop.reason: Harm 3 or higher findings: one more round by the standing rule

why: Codex Fast is on by default: a repo that leaves codex_fast out gets Fast for every fix and every repair round, and the owner wants it off unless a repo opts in
